result.question: Why were the leaders of Shechem inclined to follow Abimelech?

readings.support: for they said, “He is our brother.”

readings.answer: Because his mother’s brothers had spoken these words about him to the leaders.
readings.support: his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem | their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech

assessments.reason: Verse 3 explicitly gives the reason: “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” matching the answer that they followed him because he was their brother.

The clause “when his mother’s brothers spoke…” is temporal setup, while the text states the reason with “for they said, ‘He is our brother,’” so attributing their inclination to the uncles’ speech contradicts the stated cause.

result.reason: The passage explicitly explains their inclination with “for they said, ‘He is our brother.’”
